key_takeaways: Paperless Post, Greenvelope and Bliss & Bone send your save the date and track it for you; Canva, Greetings Island, Etsy and Zazzle give you a design or file that you send yourself.
Text is the weak link for guests in Australia: Paperless Post sends SMS to US numbers only and Bliss & Bone to the US and Canada, so plan on email, WhatsApp or a shareable link.
Greenvelope listed a single mailing from US$19 for up to 20 people, and Bliss & Bone charges US$0.90 per recipient from 10 recipients, as their own pages showed in November 2026.
Our own timeline says to send save the dates 9 to 12 months ahead once any guest travels, and to send overseas guests theirs first.
A downloaded file cannot tell you who opened it, so put your wedding website address on every design and collect replies there.

faq.q: What is an online save the date?
faq.a: It is a note sent by email, message or link, rather than by post, asking guests to hold your date. Online, digital and electronic save the dates all mean the same thing.

faq.q: Are digital save the dates tacky for a luxury wedding?
faq.a: Not when they look considered and lead somewhere useful. Greenvelope's animated envelope, liner and stamp feel close to opening real post, and a printed invitation can still follow. For a wedding abroad, a digital note also reaches guests in several countries at once, which matters when they need months to plan travel.

faq.q: Can a digital save the date collect RSVPs and addresses?
faq.a: Some can. Bliss & Bone offers optional RSVP collection, and Greenvelope tracks responses. Greenvelope's page also says it collects mailing addresses directly through the save the date, ready for paper invitations. A file from Canva, Etsy or Zazzle collects nothing on its own, so link it to your wedding website, where Wonderland Studio lets guests self-register and keeps travel details on your guest list.

faq.q: Are there free digital save the dates?
faq.a: Yes, with limits. Paperless Post has free designs, Canva's Free plan is US$0 a month, Greetings Island has free designs alongside Premium, and Bliss & Bone lets you design for free before you pay per recipient. Wonderland Studio, the website the card points to, is free with no credit card.
